name: Multimodal Image Extraction + Numerical Calculation (Differential Delta)
expected: Inlet=125 PSI, Outlet=92 PSI, Calculated Delta=33 PSI
actual:
## Differential Pressure Monitor Analysis

### Extracted Data from filter_differential.png

| Parameter | Value | Color/Style |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| **Inlet Pressure** | 125 PSI | Blue text, bold weight |
| **Outlet Pressure** | 92 PSI | Green text, bold weight |
| **Filter Stage** | #2 | Black/Grey text |

### Calculated Differential Pressure Drop

The differential pressure drop across the filter is calculated as:

$$\Delta P = \text{Inlet Pressure} - \text{Outlet Pressure}$$

$$\Delta P = 125 \text{ PSI} - 92 \text{ PSI} = \mathbf{33.0 \text{ PSI}}$$

### Summary
- **Differential pressure drop:** 33.0 PSI across Filter Stage #2
- This indicates a moderate-to-high pressure differential, which may be within normal operating parameters depending on the specific filter design specifications
